recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. The current source satisfies FHIR-13975 after the CodeableReference refactor; later target-profile changes should be reconciled under their separate Jira keys.
issue_request: FHIR-13975 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for STU3 Patient Care Procedure. It reported that Procedure.reasonReference's description only mentioned Condition even though Observation was also permitted; the final resolution kept wording generic because workflow alignment was adding DiagnosticReport and DocumentReference, requesting the short "The justification that the procedure was performed" and definition "The justification of why the procedure was performed."
initial_application: The 2017-11-13 commit 52ac1cc0e7 applied the change alongside GF#13974 and GF#14063, updating the Procedure spreadsheet so reasonReference allowed Condition, Observation, Procedure, DiagnosticReport, and DocumentReference and used the requested generic justification short and definition.
additional_context: FHIR-14063 supplied the workflow-alignment reason for adding DiagnosticReport and DocumentReference and is already audited on the combined branch. FHIR-13974 and FHIR-16346 clarified the same Procedure reason family. Current source represents the former reasonCode/reasonReference pair as Procedure.reason CodeableReference with concept/reference forms.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Procedure is active in source/fhir.ini, and source/procedure/structuredefinition-Procedure.xml already defines Procedure.reason with the requested generic short, a generic definition covering coded/text/reference justifications, and target profiles for Condition, Observation, Procedure, DiagnosticReport, and DocumentReference.
